body:
The CLI separates SDK upgrades from application-template upgrades, offers guided optional Neo4j/Memgraph setup through one shared service, and provides scoped administration and complete exports for supported legacy SDK data.

Current `dev` is merged into this work. Recent Node24.15/npm12.2/TypeScript6/AI SDK7 modernization, verified-principal/stored-grant authorization, runtime ownership protections and canonical documentation decisions are preserved. CLI administration uses internal `cliOperator/*` functions with real deployment administrator credentials. Public runtime guards retain authentication and ownership requirements; unsupported runtime exports, erasure and capabilities refuse explicitly.

Basic, Chat and Vercel applications ship through independently versioned `@cortexmemory/templates`. Automatic application replacement/mirror synchronization, detached CLI process supervision and custom JSON deployment restore are retired. Shared graph setup remains available from SDK and demo entrypoints.

Release versions: SDK/CLI/provider **0.38.0**, applications **1.2.0**, catalog **1.1.0**. Documentation companion: https://github.com/SaintNick1214/cortexmemory.dev/pull/6. No registry publication or production deployment was performed.

CI repairs make fresh candidate demos install against the exact unpublished SDK/provider archives, reset qualified disposable test deployments through native Convex import/export, and prepare reference maintenance through the existing bounded protocol. Eight native suites, including the whole GDPR cascade file, reset independently before execution. This keeps deployment-wide root-closure proofs within their declared finite transaction budget while retaining every assertion and the budget refusal itself. Managed SDK shards run one at a time against their shared deployment; provider tests follow SDK success while provider-only changes still run. Legacy administrative fixtures are separated from genuine public-identity tests; current typed refusals and persisted foreign-data controls replace obsolete success assumptions. Historical test catalogs remain visibly preserved outside active discovery.

Source fixes preserve typed Convex errors, tenant-scoped immutable history and confirmed profile-deletion receipts; ordinary Facts/vector calls use their registered public handlers. Public Facts deletion dispatches once on unknown outcome, and vector deadlines are validated before mutation. Fact discovery completes native bounded child pages without dropping their rows or queued tail. Graph adapters handle native integer IDs and engine-specific path syntax. File operations now use safe descriptor handling for the eight verified CodeQL races.

Release planning covers SDK, provider, templates and CLI in dependency order. Delivery requires successful tests, Security Scans, uploaded CodeQL and Snyk on the same source commit. Template-only updates have their own channel. Dry publication controls exercise first publication, partial retry and registry visibility without publishing.

Current local repair validation:

- CLI:869 unit cases and94 isolated-HOME backend/schema composition controls pass. The accepted audit's67 live command cases and human install/management/browser evidence remain applicable to unchanged behavior; four inherited participant cases are skipped.
- Native cascade:260/260 cases pass with original deadlines and natural process shutdown.77 independent focused controls pass. A4100-foreign-row reproduction, large-row split pagination and physical guard/rollback probes preserve unrelated data.
- Managed refusal tests:268 unique cases across10 paths pass against genuine native error redaction; assertions recognize exact structured errors and preserve public no-effect controls. Linux export/cancellation102cases and native export7cases pass.
- Real Neo4j5.26/Memgraph3.13:53SDK and4provider graph cases pass. Current hosted provider250 unit/React,74 integration and35 paid cases pass with zero skips.
- Final packed Basic/Chat/Vercel candidates:ordinary/frozen installs, exact installed SDK/provider byte associations, genuine native codegen/types, repeated current CLI composition and all three production builds pass. Previously accepted486 unchanged application tests are reused. Packed public contracts, catalog/release controls and affected quality checks pass.

The previous hosted run passed9385 SDK cases and failed six GDPR root-erasure cases with REFERENCE_NATIVE_BUDGET;211 inherited skips remain inventoried. That run remains failed evidence. Shared-deployment serialization, owned-client shutdown and bounded Facts pagination resolved the earlier contention, performance and paging failures. The entire unchanged22-case GDPR file now belongs to the mandatory isolated native gate; all222 selected managed/native paths are retained exactly once. Local regression evidence includes13 Facts cases and41 active edge/large-file cases with their original limits. The genuine erasure contention probe preserves one-send unknown-outcome behavior and succeeds on the same corpus after contention stops. Fresh native GDPR22/22 passes. A separate15MB foreign-content control preserves the typed budget refusal, incomplete receipt, owned root and all27 unrelated rows; this is a pressure control, not an exact replay of the hosted corpus. No test path, assertion, deadline, erasure budget or scanner severity gate is removed. Fresh exact-head hosted results now pass:9369 managed SDK cases/211 inherited skips, all11 paid stress cases,217 native cases (including GDPR22), CLI869unit+67e2e/four inherited skips,53SDK+4provider graph cases,250unit/React+74integration+35paid provider cases, all three demos, catalog, packed contracts, setup and code quality. PR Checks attempt2 and Security Scans are successful at477fea35e; attempt1 is preserved as a pre-test Convex codegen503 failure, repaired by a same-head failed-job rerun.

Chat's introduced vulnerable braces dependency path is removed by using the exact licensed Biome presets. Basic bounds request bytes before JSON parsing and admits bounded scalar fields before SDK effects. Its unpatched Zod finding has a narrowly scoped, reviewed mitigation policy expiring **2026-11-07**; no blanket scanner suppression is used. All current GitHub Actions and uploaded CodeQL/Trivy checks pass. Snyk still reports the unpatched Basic path and has not recognized the repository policy. A specific one-commit manual successful-status disposition is pending action-time user confirmation; none has been applied. This PR remains draft until that gate and final independent acceptance are resolved. The source policy expires November7; a manual SCM status would not expire automatically.
title: Modernize Cortex CLI installation and administration for current Convex
